scale: ORE 2015 DL development files ore_ont_4510, ore_ont_12901, ore_ont_14375, ore_ont_10951, ore_ont_5481, ore_ont_10073, ore_ont_1370, ore_ont_4755, ore_ont_11378, ore_ont_9151, ore_ont_9855, ore_ont_8737, ore_ont_14817, ore_ont_9663 and ore_ont_3215, GO 2026-07-26 and ChEBI lite 256 on atlas, and a taxonomy sweep of GO, ChEBI lite, 298 ORE 2015 EL files and 207 DL development files on the laptop

sides.tip: 3d2d4032, the reviewed lane tip with origin/main f854145b merged, which changes nothing in crates/sparkles-owl
sides.el: the tip build with --el-only, on the four assertion-heavy files

manifest.build: mbx build --release -p sparkles-owl --example el_classify on stanley, copied to atlas

settings.threads: one and four in the rounds, four only for ore_ont_14817 and ore_ont_9663 in timing and timing2, one in t1, one and eight in the sweep, four in the scan
settings.scope: one process per run in a 13 GiB systemd scope without swap on atlas, a 10 GiB scope on the laptop

method: timing.sh ran four rounds of alternating order of base and tip, one process per side, file and thread count with --repeat 5, 2 for ore_ont_8737 and 1 for ore_ont_14817 and ore_ont_9663, and in each round the tip with --el-only on the four assertion-heavy files. summ.py takes the median of every classification of a side and the median of the rounds ratios. timing2.sh ran twelve more rounds of alternating order of base and tip on ore_ont_14817 and ore_ont_9663 on four threads, one classification a process, and t1.sh ran the tip and the base once on one thread on ore_ont_14817 and ore_ont_3215 with a timeout of 900 s and the hash of the sorted taxonomy, as the sweep takes it. The sweep classified each file once per side and thread count with its taxonomy on the laptop, with a timeout of 300 s, and compared the hashes of the sorted taxonomies. The scan ran a diagnostic build of the base, which counts witnesses, world classes and the time of the worlds, on every DL development file on four threads on the laptop.
